p=subprocess.run(["sudo","-n","--","/usr/bin/python3","-c",""""Read-only audit of the owner's named VivoAPK/PINK vault and retired paths.
No key values, provider addresses, credentials, arbitrary config names,
or archive content leave the VPS. No connections to media or VPN endpoints.
"""
import json, os, re, stat, subprocess, socket, shutil, shlex, time
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

R={"phase":"r104-pink-vault-audit","read_only":True,"secrets_emitted":False,
   "media_requests":0,"provider_mutations":0,"deleted_bytes":0}
PROTECTED=("vivoapk-backend.service","jellyfin-pink.service","nginx.service","postgresql.service")
RETIRED=("pink-iptv-backend.service","pink-vpn.service")
KNOWN_ROOT=Path("/root/project-secrets")
VIVO_VAULT=KNOWN_ROOT/"VIVOAPK"
PINK_PATH=Path("/srv/projects/pink-iptv")
DEADLINE=time.monotonic()+50

def ctl(unit,prop):
    p=subprocess.run(["systemctl","show",unit,"--property="+prop,"--value","--no-pager"],
       capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
    return p.stdout.strip() if p.returncode==0 else ""

def health_socket(path,route):
    try:
        with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX) as client:
            client.settimeout(4)
            client.connect(str(path))
            client.sendall(("GET "+route+" HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n").encode("ascii"))
            return b" 200 " in client.recv(256).split(b"\r\n",1)[0]
    except OSError:return False

def real_dir(path):
    return path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink() and path.resolve()==path

def state():
    return {u:{"active":ctl(u,"ActiveState")=="active","pid":ctl(u,"MainPID")} for u in PROTECTED}

def private_text(path):
    if path.is_symlink():return None,"symlink_skipped"
    try:
        fd=os.open(path,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_NONBLOCK)
        with os.fdopen(fd,"rb") as f:
            st=os.fstat(f.fileno())
            if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) or st.st_size>512*1024:return None,"unsafe_type_or_size"
            if st.st_uid!=0 or st.st_mode&0o077:return None,"not_root_private"
            data=f.read(512*1024+1)
            if len(data)>512*1024:return None,"oversized"
            return data.decode("utf-8","strict"),"read"
    except (OSError,UnicodeError):return None,"not_available"

def parse_env(raw):
    out={}
    for line in raw.splitlines():
        line=line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:continue
        k,v=line.removeprefix("export ").split("=",1)
        k=k.strip()
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*",k):continue
        try:
            parts=shlex.split(v,comments=True)
            if len(parts)==1 and parts[0]:out[k.upper()]=parts[0]
        except ValueError:continue
    return out

def scheme(value):
    try:
        p=urlsplit(value)
        return p.scheme.lower() if p.hostname and p.scheme.lower() in ("http","https") else "not_origin"
    except ValueError:return "not_origin"

def inspect_env(paths):
    counts={"files_read":0,"files_absent_or_skipped":0,"api_token_present":False,
       "api_base_https":False,"private_media_key_present":False,
       "provider_secure_transport_fields":0,"provider_https_origin_fields":0,
       "old_local_vpn_gateway_configured":False,"wireguard_config_files":0}
    for path in paths:
        raw,reason=private_text(path)
        if raw is None:
            counts["files_absent_or_skipped"]+=1
            continue
        counts["files_read"]+=1
        if path.suffix.lower()==".conf" and re.search(r"(?im)^\s*\[Peer\]\s*$",raw) and re.search(r"(?im)^\s*\[Interface\]\s*$",raw):
            counts["wireguard_config_files"]+=1
        d=parse_env(raw)
        counts["api_token_present"]|=bool(d.get("MEGA_OTT_API_TOKEN"))
        counts["api_base_https"]|=scheme(d.get("MEGA_OTT_API_BASE",""))=="https"
        counts["private_media_key_present"]|=bool(d.get("PRIVATE_MEDIA_KEY"))
        counts["old_local_vpn_gateway_configured"]|=bool(d.get("VPN_CONTROL_SOCKET") or (d.get("VPN_ENDPOINT") and d.get("VPN_SERVER_PUBLIC_KEY")))
        for k,v in d.items():
            if k=="MEGA_OTT_API_BASE":continue
            if re.search(r"(MEGA|XTREAM|UPSTREAM|PROVIDER|MEDIA|DNS|ORIGIN)",k):
                if re.search(r"(VPN|TUNNEL|TLS|HTTPS|SSL|PROXY)",k):counts["provider_secure_transport_fields"]+=1
                if re.search(r"(DNS|ORIGIN|MEDIA_URL|STREAM_URL)",k) and scheme(v)=="https":counts["provider_https_origin_fields"]+=1
    return counts

def candidate_config_files(base):
    # Only the known project-local directories/filenames. No search of
    # unrelated vaults, databases, user home files or raw backup archives.
    if not real_dir(base):return []
    out=[]
    names={"backend-auth.env","backend-runtime.env","native-media.env","backend.env",
           "secrets.env","mega.env","provider.env","vpn.env","wireguard.conf","wg0.conf"}
    roots=[base,base/"private/systemd-env",base/"systemd-env",base/"private",base/"config"]
    for root in roots:
        if not real_dir(root):continue
        for p in root.iterdir():
            if p.name.lower() in names and not p.is_symlink() and p.is_file():
                out.append(p)
    return sorted(set(out),key=str)[:40]

def backup_inventory():
    # Scan only immediate children explicitly labelled PINK, not the
    # Jellyfin service that retains a historical "-pink" service name.
    found={}
    for root in (Path("/srv/projects"),Path("/srv/backups"),Path("/var/backups"),
                 Path("/root/backups"),Path("/srv/projects/Vivoapk/backups"),
                 Path("/srv/projects/backups"),Path("/srv/projects/_retired")):
        if not real_dir(root):continue
        for p in root.iterdir():
            if not re.search(r"pink[-_. ]?iptv|retiring[-_. ]?pink|pink[-_. ]?backup|backup[-_. ]?pink|pink[-_. ]?vpn",p.name,re.I):continue
            if p==PINK_PATH or p.is_symlink():continue
            if not (p.is_file() or real_dir(p)):continue
            # Exact path is kept private; counts and disk bytes only.
            found[str(p)]=p
    selected=list(found.values())[:12]
    total=0;measured=0;config=[]
    for p in selected:
        if time.monotonic()>DEADLINE-8:break
        if p.is_dir():
            config.extend(candidate_config_files(p))
            config.extend(candidate_config_files(p/"project"))
        try:
            # -x stays on this filesystem; no symlink following.
            v=subprocess.run(["du","-s","-x","-B1","--",str(p)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=7)
            if v.returncode==0:
                total+=int(v.stdout.split()[0]);measured+=1
        except (ValueError,IndexError,subprocess.TimeoutExpired):pass
    return {"candidates":len(found),"measured":measured,"allocated_bytes":total,
            "archive_contents_inspected":False,"config_audit":inspect_env(sorted(set(config),key=str)[:40])}

def run():
    first=state()
    R["protected_services_initially_active"]=all(v["active"] for v in first.values())
    R["pink_legacy"]={
      "old_project_present":PINK_PATH.exists(),
      "old_services_active":sum(ctl(u,"ActiveState")=="active" for u in RETIRED),
      "old_unit_files_present":sum((Path("/etc/systemd/system")/u).exists() for u in RETIRED),
      "old_vpn_config_directory_present":Path("/etc/pink-vpn").is_dir(),
      "old_vpn_state_directory_present":Path("/var/lib/pink-vpn").is_dir()}
    R["vivo_vault_exists"]=real_dir(VIVO_VAULT)
    vp=candidate_config_files(VIVO_VAULT)
    R["vivo_vault"]=inspect_env(vp)
    pp=[]
    if real_dir(KNOWN_ROOT):
        for p in KNOWN_ROOT.iterdir():
            if "pink" in p.name.casefold() and real_dir(p):pp.extend(candidate_config_files(p))
    pp.extend(candidate_config_files(PINK_PATH))
    R["pink_vault_and_runtime"]=inspect_env(sorted(set(pp),key=str)[:40])
    R["pink_backup_inventory"]=backup_inventory()
    R["free_bytes"]=shutil.disk_usage("/srv/projects").free
    R["backend_socket_healthy"]=health_socket("/srv/projects/Vivoapk/run/backend.sock","/openapi.json")
    R["jellyfin_socket_healthy"]=health_socket("/srv/projects/jellyfin-server/run/jellyfin.sock","/System/Info/Public")
    R["protected_services_unchanged"]=first==state()
    R["status"]="checked"
try:run()
